text:
maria: kicking off region bring-up checklist for ap-south-2, focus is GPU pool + TF/Pulumi state wiring. tagging folks. :wave:
ben: ack. do we have quota requested for H100s in that region? last time support said 6 weeks.
zara: we opened the quota ticket yesterday, reference #RQ-2045. cloud says provisional approval for 4 nodes. asking for expedite.
alex: quick note — we should validate VPC CIDR planning before we touch state. last time overlapping peer routes caused a routing loop.
ben: plan is: 1) create networking stack (Pulumi) 2) bootstrap control plane (Terraform modules) 3) provision GPU pool (Pulumi) 4) wire remote state + CI.
maria: agreed. two important constraints: a) remote state must be S3 + DynamoDB (locking) in shared infra account, b) pipelines need an ephemeral assume-role pattern (no long-lived keys).
azara: small correction: it's me -> zara, but also ensure KMS CMKs are created in customer infra account for private deploys. For hosted, we use global KMS key.
ben: putting sample backend config here for TF (copy into infra repo pipeline step):
```hcl
terraform {
  backend "s3" {
    bucket = "rw-infra-remote-state"
    key    = "regions/ap-south-2/terraform.tfstate"
    region = "us-east-1"
    encrypt = true
    dynamodb_table = "rw-terraform-locks"
  }
}
```
ben: Pulumi stacks will use the same S3 bucket for checkpoints and a locking wrapper in the CICD step.
maria: pipeline snippet for assume-role (GitHub Actions example):
```yaml
- name: Assume infra role
  uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
  with:
    role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rw-infra-deploy
    aws-region: ap-south-2
```
azara: important: the role needs kms:Decrypt for the region CMK and s3:GetObject/PutObject on the state prefix. Add condition restricting to the pipeline session tag.
alex: validation hooks we should include post-provision: 1) control-plane healthcheck (helm probe), 2) run small canary model load (generate 256 tokens), 3) check KV caching works across nodes.
maria: agree. I'll add automated smoke job in CI: `scripts/region-smoke.sh` that does the canary.
ben: note on networking: avoid IGW attachments in the GPU subnet. Use NAT + egress-only patterns to keep attacks surface small.
azara: subnet plan: 3 AZs, /22 each for worker subnets, private + isolated control-plane. add route table notes in runbook.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: new TF plan finished for `networks/ap-south-2` — 7 resources to add.
sre-oncall: can we add cost tag enforcement in the TF plan? GPUs are expensive, tag ownership + cost-center required or CI should fail.
ben: yes, `provider` override in module will inject `tags = local.common_tags`. we fail pipeline if missing.
maria: edge cases: if the S3 bucket already has a key for that region from an old experiment, pipeline should refuse to overwrite unless `--force` flag and owner ack. add check to `infra/ci/preflight.sh`.
alex: also add a state migration note: if migrating from Pulumi-only to mixed TF + Pulumi, snapshot Pulumi checkpoints and run `pulumi stack export` and store under `migrations/`. record the migration id in the ticket.
ben: who wants to own the handoff doc to oncall? need step-by-step runbook and a small rollback plan (scale down to 0 + fall back to eu-west-1).
maria: I'll draft the handoff in `docs/region-onboard/ap-south-2.md` and include the checklist: quotas, roles, backends, smoke, alerting, cost watch.
azara: I'll validate cloud provider limits and update quota ticket with region roadmap.
infra-bot: reminder: please run `./infra/ci/preflight.sh --check-state` before applying.
sre-oncall: tagging a follow-up: add alert for GPU eviction rate > 1% in first 24h, and cost burn > $xxx/day alarm.
maria: thanks. next step: ben will open PR for TF backend + Pulumi stack, alex will add smoke job, zara will confirm quotas. target: merge by EOD Friday. :rocket:
ben: starting PR now. I'll ping reviewers. :eyes:
alex: I'll add smoke job and a tiny canary model `gpt-mini` config to test latency.
azara: updating quota ticket and posting ETA.
maria: perfect — will update the runbook with the snippets and link to PRs. final note: keep manual intervention steps minimal; prefer safe gating in CI.
